n, b = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
diff = [0] * n
index = 0
evenCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
oddCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else 0

for i in range(1, n):
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        diff[index] = abs(a[i] - a[i - 1])
        index += 1
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

diff = sorted(diff[:index])
sum_diff = 0
count = 0
for d in diff:
    if d + sum_diff <= b:
        count += 1
        sum_diff += d

print(count)
</translated_code>
